name: IFX Alajuela (formerly ADN Datacenters Costa Rica)
notes: Tier III colocation facility in Saret Free Zone / Building B8, Rio Segundo, Alajuela; Data Center Map notes March 2025 acquisition of ADN by IFX Networks. Uptime Institute lists Datacenter Costa Rica in Alajuela for ADN Datacenters.

name: ICE Data Center Guatuso
notes: Strategic ICE Group data center at Estacion Terrena de Guatuso, San Isidro, Cartago; Data Center Map describes Tier 3 certifications and operational building details.

name: Continum Datacenter S.A.
notes: Private cloud, cybersecurity, colocation and business continuity facility on Campus Invenio GML in Canas, Guanacaste; Data Center Map lists 1 MW.

name: Kyndryl Costa Rica Data Center
notes: Datacenters.com lists a Kyndryl colocation data center at America Free Zone Park, Heredia Province; Kyndryl official locations page confirms the Costa Rica site at Parque Zona Franca America, Heredia.

name: Banco Nacional de Costa Rica Santo Domingo Data Center
notes: Banco Nacional invested US$35 million in a new data center in Santo Domingo de Heredia; contractor pages identify the BNCR project in San Miguel de Santo Domingo, Heredia, with construction references around 2020-2023.

name: Grupo Codisa / IFX-CODISA Limon Data Center
notes: Weak evidence only: a Grupo Codisa / IFX-CODISA job listing sought data center operators for Limon and San Jose. I did not find a facility profile or official project page for Limon, so status/capacity are left unknown.

name: In-Pursuit Puntarenas secured development site
notes: Digerati/GlobeNewswire announcement says In-Pursuit has two additional secured development sites in San Jose and 'Punterenas' (interpreted as Puntarenas), Costa Rica, as part of green data-center and energy projects targeting 600 MW by 2030. Specific local site/capacity not disclosed.

name: Navégalo San José / Costa Rica Data Center
notes: DCD reported 300-rack San Jose facility opening August 15, 2023; phase one 5 MW, scalable to 15 MW. Navégalo site now markets the Costa Rica Tier III/Rated-3 data center as live.

name: SC Zeus San Jose
notes: Baxtel/Tico Times list SC Zeus in San Jose as Costa Rica's largest listed facility at about 12.5-13 MW; operator official site is broad APAC-focused and did not expose a Costa Rica facility page in search results.

name: IFX San Jose
notes: Data Center Map lists IFX San Jose at Avenida 45, Anselmo Llorente; Uptime Institute award list references Codisa Data Center I/II and NAP de Centroamerica in San Jose under Ideas Gloris/CODISA.

name: Critical Colocation San Jose Data Center
notes: Tier III downtown San Jose colocation and virtualization facility at Av. 10 & Calle 13 with 2N power infrastructure and multiple carrier entrances per Data Center Map.

name: RackNation San Pedro
notes: RackNation CR1 at Av. 14, San Pedro; Data Center Map timeline says operational from 2012 and lists colocation/cloud/bare metal services.

name: RackNation Curridabat
notes: RackNation CR2 at Diagonal 48 & Transversal 69, Curridabat; Data Center Map timeline says operational from July 10, 2020.

name: Data Center Costa Rica
notes: Costa Rican company with its own DataCenter 10G in Barrio Tournon, San Jose, providing hosting, colocation and data center services.

name: Costa Rica Servers
notes: Costa Rica Servers provides hosting/colocation from leased rack space in Costa Rica's primary telecom carrier facility, with San Jose team support; Data Center Map locates the facility at Edificio Trifami, Av. 1.

name: UFINET Escazú
notes: Data Center Map lists UFINET Escazu at Ofibodegas Ultima Park, San Jose, designed with double fiber optic entrances, double AAP and double UPS-rectifier per suite.

name: Servers Lodge Data Center
notes: Cyberfuel Servers Lodge facility at Parque Empresarial FORUM 1; Data Center Map lists 24x7x365 NOC/tech support, Tier 3 and ISO27001, with operational timeline from 2001.

name: In-Pursuit San Pedro production facility
notes: Digerati/GlobeNewswire announcement says In-Pursuit currently operates a production facility in San Pedro, Costa Rica, as part of green data-center and energy projects; capacity not disclosed.

name: In-Pursuit Escazú production facility
notes: Digerati/GlobeNewswire announcement says In-Pursuit currently operates a production facility in Escazu, Costa Rica, as part of green data-center and energy projects; capacity not disclosed.

name: In-Pursuit San Jose secured development site
notes: Digerati/GlobeNewswire announcement says In-Pursuit has an additional secured development site in San Jose, Costa Rica, under a green data-center platform targeting 600 MW by 2030. Specific site/capacity not disclosed.
